source_context: The publisher abstract describes hydrographic observations in December 1987 and January 1988. It reports approximate widths of 400 km near 10 degrees N and 100 km near 22 degrees N, with differing vertical extents. These are spatially distinct winter descriptions.
measurement_rules: Two different latitudes do not establish an annual minimum/maximum width range.
Reported current depth is not automatically the fixed velocity-averaging layer of a width measurement.
An abstract does not supply unseen edge definitions, reference velocities, paired boundary locations or numerical uncertainty.
Do not silently repair a later thesis citation or substitute the summer study for the winter original.
